description: Returns the block types in the library with their descriptions, configurable parameters, and exact input/output port IDs. Without a filter it returns a compact list of all types; with a list of type IDs it returns full details for those types. Example port IDs: Step out "out"; Sum in "in", out "out"; Gain in "in", out "out"; PIDController in "error","reset", out "out"; uPlotDisplay in "signal". Common aliases (e.g. "in" for PID error, "in" for uPlotDisplay signal, "+" / "-" for Subtraction) are resolved automatically.

filter.description: Optional: List of block type IDs to get full details for. If omitted, returns a compact list of all blocks.

name: get_available_blocks
title: List available blocks
